definitions.explanation: Firm belief in the reliability or ability of someone or something.
The ability to obtain goods or services before payment based on trust that payment will be made in the future.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{言葉|ことば}は{信用|しんよう}できる。
{一度|いちど}{失|うしな}った{信用|しんよう}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}すのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to regain trust once it's lost.

examples.japanese: {信用|しんよう}カードで{支払|しはら}った。
examples.english: I paid with a credit card.

notes:
{信用|しんよう}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to trust."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信用|しんよう}する (to trust)
- {信用|しんよう}できる (trustworthy)
- {信用|しんよう}を{失|うしな}う (to lose trust)
- {信用|しんよう}を{得|え}る (to gain trust)
- {信用|しんよう}カード (credit card)
- {信用|しんよう}{金庫|きんこ} (credit union)

COMPARISON:
- {信用|しんよう}: trust (often practical, ability-based)
- {信頼|しんらい}: trust (deeper, character-based)
